notes.title: Cartoon Rage v1.0.1 & v1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Uncapped FPS
[*] Fixed pending translations
[*] Enabled russian and japanese translations
[*] Reduced all cannonball speeds by 5 to 10%
[*] Increased delay between shots by 5 to 10%
[*] Increased all platform sizes by 15%
[*] Fixed bug that would make platforms invisible at the start of level 3
[*] Overall performance improvements
[/list]
